P+R in his last five games was 18, 10, 10, 31 and 17, so he went over 16.5 three times. Season averages of 11.1 pts and 5.2 reb (about 16.3) sit right at the line, and he played 24-32 minutes. No current injury tag was found.

CBS lists Kuzma as the starting PF and says Ousmane Dieng is out with a finger injury until at least Nov 18, so Kuzma's role looks secure. Its page-age label conflicts with the current-season content, so treat it with caution. No analyst pick on this market was found.

NBA.com's game log shows Zubac had 0, 1 and 1 assists in his last three games (Nov 9–13) while playing 26 to 31 minutes. His bigger minutes after the ankle injury have not led to more assists, which fits the Under 1.5.

ESPN lists his 2026-27 average at 1.6 assists per game over 8 games, just above the 1.5 line. He had 2 or more assists in 4 of those 8 games, including 5 in only 19 minutes against Denver on Nov 7 and 2 in a 7-minute game, so the line is close to a coin flip.

The Pacers' Nov 15 preview lists Zubac as the probable starting center, with Nembhard, Nesmith, Oubre and Siakam; Haliburton is not among the probable starters. Philadelphia's probable center is Jabari Walker. In the last meeting, Nembhard had 14 assists while Zubac was out.
